chapter: Blind Charlie, kin and early memories
title: Where Blind Charlie is now, and his missing last name
summary: The group tries to identify Blind Charlie, whom Barnes met a year ago, and Barnes explains musicians are known by first names only.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
